verdict.rationale: Fly.io's docs show deployment fits existing frameworks ('docs specific to your tech') and keeps a stable API across scale without re-architecting, implying compatibility with existing app structures, but the evidence pack has no explicit mention of Git-based deploy workflows, CI/CD pipeline integration, or editor/IDE compatibility — it centers on the flyctl CLI as the primary interface. Missing for 10: concrete CI integration docs (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), Git-push deploy workflow evidence, and confirmation that no Fly-specific code/config lock-in is required beyond flyctl.
